parsedVerdict.reasoning: OrderService is a Service Layer in the business (domain) layer. Most of its work fits that role. placeOrder and cancelOrder run use cases through injected gateways and domain objects (Product.reserve, Order.cancel, PricingPolicy). getOrder turns a missing record into a BusinessError. The method placeOrderFromRequest is different. It takes an Express Request, reads request.body['customerId'] and request.body['items'], and converts and defaults those values. Reading an HTTP request and turning its body into use-case input is transport work. It belongs to the presentation layer (OrderController), not the domain. The import of the express package is an import-direction issue, so this verdict does not count it. The violation is that the class takes on request-decoding work.
